decisionsTitle: Every email a staff press sends carries its press, and «Emailuri azi» lists the day's emails
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-03** (his four choices, as the design «telling the owner about every email a staff press sends» records them): every staff press that sends an email should say so before the press, say after it what left and when, let him untick the person's email where that is sensible, and there should be one list of every email of the day. The design builds it in four slices on one backbone; this branch carries them, each slice adding its decisions here.

**Slice 1 — the backbone and the day's list.**

- **Every row says what queued it.** Two columns on `email_outbox`, expand only (migration `0189_email_press`): `cause`, a closed token of the press or the job (`notifications/domain/press-causes.ts`: `registrations.cancel`, `volunteers.assign`, `job.registrationMaintenance`, … with the main emails each press sends the person it acts on, for the toast of slice 2), and `press_id`, one id per press or job run shared by every row it queued — the person's message, the club's copies, an offer to the next in line. Neither holds personal data. `requested_by_staff_user_id` is now filled by every staff press (a requester the service names still wins); only the manual-resend history reads it, so nothing on screen changes.
- **The email press scope** (`notifications/press.ts`): every emailing Server Action of the design's list — 44 presses across registrations, events, volunteers and the club — wraps its whole body in `inEmailPress("<cause>", …)` and names its actor with `press.by(actor.id)` right after its staff check; the two job routes open the jobs' scopes, and so do the drains that do the outbox job's work after a response (Next's `after()` carries a request's async scopes into its callback, and a road's notice queued there is the job's, never the press's). `AsyncLocalStorage`, part of Node — no new dependency — rather than React's per-request `cache`, which the road choice already hedges may not hold in a Server Action. A public flow opens none: its rows read «de pe site». `enqueueEmail`, the club's copies (per message and per bulk send) and the relay stamp each row from the scope; the scope labels rows and never decides whether or when one leaves. Presses that queue nothing themselves open none: «Trimite acum», publishing (the job queues the alerts under its own scope), Zitadel's password link, the timing and road settings. `tests/unit/shared/emailing-presses.test.ts` holds every listed press to its scope and its actor, refuses a scope in an unlisted action or on a public flow.
- **One judgement of when a waiting email leaves** (`notifications/domain/departure.ts#departureOf`, moved from the queue panel): the queue, «Emailuri azi» and the toast of slice 2 ask it. Two things it says that the queue did not: «Pleacă acum» for a row the «imediat» timing's drain is still sending (queued a moment ago, never tried), and «Pleacă după ce Mailgun reia: HH:MM (estimat).» for a Mailgun-road row while Mailgun is stopped and nothing carries it, or while a Free plan's day is spent. The late judgement is health's, unchanged.
- **«Emailuri azi»** (`/admin/settings/emails/today`, «Setări» → «Emailuri» stays marked): every email of the club's day — left since midnight on the club's clock, waiting from any day, failed or refused today — with the person's name and address, in two sections, «Așteaptă acum» then «Au plecat azi», one row per press with its moment, its cause in words and who pressed («automat: …» for a job, «De pe site» for a row no press queued). The name comes from the registration, the volunteer's row (the parent's on the parent's link) or the colleague's account found by its canonical address. The club's own mailboxes — a copy, the declaration's archive, «cineva a confirmat» — fold under the message they copy or under their press, by the audience map (Critic correction 4), never counted as people. More than five lines of one email in one press fold behind one line that says how many. Never the payload's words, a body, a link or a provider's detail beyond a failed row's sanitized reason; capped at 2000 rows with «Și încă N».
- **The "am I sending too much" signal** (Critic correction 5, which overrides the design's "three or more emails today"): three emails is the ordinary registration journey, so the warning at the top lists only **the same email to the same person twice or more today**, counted by the canonical address (AGENTS.md §10.4, never a raw compare) on the person's own mail — never the club's or a colleague's notices — and on real rows only. The design's count is kept as a quiet chip on each line of a person who got three or more emails today. A test registration's row is marked «Test» and counted nowhere (AGENTS.md §12.6).
- **Who reads it:** the Administrator and the Superadministrator alone, asserted by the page on the server (`requireStaffCapability(canManageRegistrations)`, BR-REQ-060-01): it names people and addresses they already read on the list, in the exports and in the queue. The desk's roles, the Organizer and the Tehnic role are refused before a row is read; the links — the «Emailuri» tab, the queue panel's «Vezi ce a plecat azi», «Emailuri de trimis» on «Înscrieri» — are drawn only for the two roles.

**Refused or left for later, and why.** The queue panel stays the reader of what waits for the club's verbs, and the page keeps «Așteaptă acum» as the build asked; the two share one judgement of each row's time (Critic correction 10 asked to fold the page into the panel instead). Zitadel's own emails are not in our queue and the page says so: listing them needs an audit row per Zitadel call in the staff presses (Critic correction 8), left for a later slice. A message withdrawn before it left is deleted to free its key and so is not listed; the page says that too. No other day (`?day=`) and no Organizer view.
changelogLine: - **«Emailuri azi» and the press behind every email** — every staff press that can send an email now stamps its rows with what was pressed, by whom and one id per press; «Setări» → «Emailuri» → «Emailuri azi» lists the day's emails with the names, what waits and what left, by press, and who got the same email twice — for the Administrator and the Superadministrator. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a staff press that queues email, when its rows are committed, then every one of them — the person's message, the club's copies of it, a bulk send's one copy, an offer to the next in line — carries the press's cause, one press id shared by all of them and the staff member who pressed as its requester (a requester the service names wins); the two job routes and the drains after a response stamp the job's cause and their own run's id; a row a public flow queues carries none; and the stamp never changes whether or when a row leaves (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Setări» → «Emailuri» → «Emailuri azi», then it lists every email of the club's day — left since midnight on the club's clock, waiting from any day, failed or refused today — with the person's name and address, «Așteaptă acum» before «Au plecat azi», one row per press with its moment, its cause and who pressed; a club mailbox's row folds under the message it copies or its press and is never counted as a person; the same email sent to the same person twice or more today, by the canonical address and on the person's own mail only, is listed at the top; and a test registration's row is marked and left out of every count (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 23. Given a waiting row on the queue panel or «Emailuri azi», then its departure is one judgement for both: «Pleacă acum» while the «imediat» timing's drain is still sending a row queued a moment ago and never tried, and «Pleacă după ce Mailgun reia» with the hour while Mailgun is stopped and nothing carries a Mailgun-road row, or a Free plan's day is spent; the late mark is unchanged (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Emailuri azi», when anyone but an Administrator or a Superadministrator opens it — a desk role, the Organizer, the Tehnic role — then the page refuses on the server before it reads a row, and its links on the «Emailuri» tab, the queue panel and «Emailuri de trimis» are drawn only for the two roles (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: every staff press's emails carry their press, and «Emailuri azi» lists the day's emails by press
